name: WWE
description: World Wrestling Entertainment — the world's largest professional wrestling promotion, home of Raw, SmackDown, NXT, and year-round Premium Live Events. Part of TKO Group Holdings.

name: AEW
description: All Elite Wrestling — founded in 2019 by Tony Khan, featuring Dynamite, Collision, and Rampage. The primary mainstream alternative to WWE.

name: New Japan Pro-Wrestling
description: Japan's premier wrestling promotion, founded in 1972. Known for strong-style wrestling, the G1 Climax tournament, and annual Wrestle Kingdom at the Tokyo Dome.

name: Impact Wrestling
description: Formerly TNA, Impact Wrestling is a major American promotion known for its X Division, Knockouts division, and long-running TV history.

name: Ring of Honor
description: Ring of Honor — now owned by Tony Khan/AEW, a pioneering pure wrestling promotion that launched the careers of CM Punk, Daniel Bryan, and many others.

name: NWA
description: The National Wrestling Alliance — one of the oldest wrestling organizations in history, revived as a modern promotion under Billy Corgan.

name: MLW
description: Major League Wrestling — an American promotion with a hybrid combat sports and sports entertainment approach, known for Fusion TV and Battle Riot.

name: GCW
description: Game Changer Wrestling — known for The Collective events, hardcore/deathmatch style, and a cult indie following with frequent international co-promotions.

name: Pro Wrestling Guerrilla
description: Southern California independent promotion famous for BOLA (Battle of Los Angeles), intimate venues, and launching future WWE, AEW, and NJPW stars.

name: CMLL
description: Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre — the world's oldest active wrestling promotion (founded 1933), home of authentic Mexican lucha libre at Arena México.

name: Lucha Libre AAA
description: Mexico's second-largest lucha libre promotion known for spectacular high-flying, TripleMania events, and launching El Hijo del Vikingo to global stardom.

name: The Crash
description: Major Mexican independent promotion based in Tijuana, known for international partnerships and blending lucha libre with North American-style wrestling.

name: Pro Wrestling NOAH
description: Japanese promotion founded in 2000 by Mitsuharu Misawa, known for hard-hitting strong-style and the prestigious GHC Championship.

name: All Japan Pro Wrestling
description: AJPW, founded in 1972 by Giant Baba — a legendary Japanese promotion known for King's Road style, Triple Crown Championship, and world-class tournament wrestling.

name: STARDOM World
description: Japan's premier women's wrestling promotion streaming service, home of Mayu Iwatani, Giulia, and the 5STAR Grand Prix tournament.

name: DDT Pro-Wrestling
description: Japanese promotion mixing comedy with serious in-ring action, known for unconventional matches and launching Konosuke Takeshita to international fame.

name: Dragon Gate
description: Japanese promotion evolved from Toryumon, known for its fast-paced high-flying style and unique faction warfare booking.

name: Progress Wrestling
description: One of the UK's most influential independent promotions. Launched careers of Pete Dunne, Gunther, and Toni Storm. Operates Chapter events in London.

name: Revolution Pro Wrestling
description: UK's leading promotion with NJPW ties, hosting the British J Cup and Uprising events. A major launch platform for British wrestling talent.

name: Insane Championship Wrestling
description: Scotland's top wrestling promotion known for its rowdy atmosphere, ultra-violence, and the annual Fear & Loathing pay-per-view in Glasgow.

name: wXw
description: Westside Xtreme Wrestling — Germany's premier wrestling promotion known for high-quality in-ring action and pan-European talent.

name: Over The Top Wrestling
description: Ireland's top wrestling promotion based in Dublin, known for its intense fanbase and producing stars like Jordan Devlin and Scotty Davis.

name: Big Japan Wrestling
description: Japanese hardcore and deathmatch wrestling promotion known for brutal barbed wire matches and a strong-style hybrid event format.

name: NJPW World
description: NJPW's official streaming platform with live events, archives of classic matches, and on-demand content from New Japan Pro-Wrestling.

name: HonorClub
description: Ring of Honor and AEW's streaming platform featuring ROH TV, pay-per-view replays, and classic archive ROH footage.

name: Cagematch
description: The world's most comprehensive professional wrestling database with wrestler profiles, match ratings, event history, and results going back decades.

name: Fightful
description: Sean Ross Sapp's wrestling news site known for breaking backstage reports and exclusive news across WWE, AEW, NJPW, and the independent scene.

name: Wrestling Observer
description: Dave Meltzer's Wrestling Observer — the industry's most authoritative news source since 1983, known for the star ratings system and deep insider reporting.

name: PWInsider
description: One of wrestling's premier news sites with Mike Johnson's backstage reports, TV results, and breaking news from WWE and across the industry.
